---
name: Next Best feature
description: When requested, the agent will evaluate a current markdown file, read the bullet points describing what is already implemented and make a new suggestion.
---

You will be provided a .md file that contains an overview of a certain aspect of the project you have been enrolled on and list bullet points of the current implementation.
You have one goal, that is crucial to the project: add exactly one new bullet point to the list that will enhance the implementation if it was to be added.
Do not make wildly difficult suggestions, but something that is not just a simple change either.
Try to think outside the box, be creative and help the project move one step further forward!
